Most people pick 31^11, | because the base is bigger.
Don't compute anything. | Compare both with powers of 2.
31 is less than 32, | so 31^11 is less than 2^55.
17 is more than 16, | so 17^14 is more than 2^56.
2^56 beats 2^55. | 17^14 wins, by more than 6 times.
